metadata.title: Reply to Comments
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Post replies to each addressed PR comment thread via Azure DevOps MCP tools. Replies notify reviewers that their feedback has been addressed, with category-specific reply templates. Only runs after fixes have been committed and pushed.

output.description: Replies posted to PR comment threads

prerequisites: Fixes committed and pushed (implementation.commitHash available in memory)
fixPlan.comments available in memory with categorized comments
repository.id and pullRequestId available in memory
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read context → generate replies → post via MCP → record results
Reply to ALL addressed comments — not just 'Valid' ones. 'Disagree' comments get a justification reply.
All replies MUST be prefixed with 'Generated: ' on the first line to indicate AI authorship
If a reply fails to post, log the error and continue with remaining replies — do not stop the step
One reply per thread — do not spam multiple replies
tools: mcp__azuredevops__repo_pull_request_thread_write - Post reply to a PR comment thread
bestPractices: Keep replies concise and focused on what was done
Reference the specific change that addressed the feedback
Stay professional — even when disagreeing, maintain a collaborative tone
For 'Partial' comments, clearly state what was done and what still needs discussion
Log each reply attempt with success/failure status for traceability

replyTemplates.valid:
Generated: 
Fixed in the latest commit. {description of change}
replyTemplates.partial:
Generated: 
Partially addressed. {what was done}. {what needs discussion}
replyTemplates.disagree:
Generated: 
After consideration, the current approach is correct because {justification}. Happy to discuss further.

substeps.name: Read Context
substeps.description: Load categorized comments and repository context from memory
actions: Read fixPlan.comments, repository.id, pullRequestId from memory
Read implementation.commitHash to reference in replies
Build list of comments to reply to (all categories)
Log: 'Preparing replies for {count} comment threads'

substeps.name: Generate Replies
substeps.description: Create category-specific reply text for each comment
actions: For each categorized comment, generate reply using the appropriate template:
Valid: 'Generated: \nFixed in the latest commit. {brief description of change}'
Partial: 'Generated: \nPartially addressed. {what was done}. {what needs discussion}'
Disagree: 'Generated: \nAfter consideration, the current approach is correct because {justification}. Happy to discuss further.'
Store generated replies alongside their threadIds

substeps.name: Post Replies via MCP
substeps.description: Post each reply to its PR comment thread
actions: For each reply:
Call mcp__azuredevops__repo_pull_request_thread_write with repositoryId, pullRequestId, threadId, and reply content
If successful: add to posted list
If failed: log error, add to failed list, continue with remaining replies
Log: 'Posted {posted} replies, {failed} failures'

substeps.name: Store Results in Memory
substeps.description: Record reply results for downstream steps
actions: Write to memory: replies.posted (list of threadIds successfully replied to), replies.failed (list of threadIds that failed with error details)
Note total posted vs failed count

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: All comment threads received a reply attempt
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: Read context → Generate category-specific replies → Post each via MCP (continue on failure) → Store results → Compliance check

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: fixPlan.comments, repository.id, pullRequestId, implementation.commitHash from previous steps
fields: Information Produced: replies.posted (threadIds), replies.failed (threadIds with errors)
Decisions Made: Reply text per category
Notes: Any failed replies with error messages
